data.completion_memo: Implemented the local-store canonical configuration and workflow JSON repositories. Editable documents retain exact schema-versioned JSON bytes (including unknown fields), content-addressed immutable body generations, manifest-only derived indexes, inter-process locked optimistic compare-and-swap versions, atomic temp-write/fsync/rename publication, manifest/body hash validation, bounded document size, and explicit corruption/schema/conflict failures. Added unit coverage for exact unknown-workflow round trips, stale-writer rejection, and required schemaVersion validation; cargo test -p aworkit-local-store passes.
data.description: Implement schema-versioned application/project configuration and workflow document repositories with optimistic version checks, atomic durable writes, and lossless round trips for unknown workflow nodes and fields. JSON remains the sole editable canonical body; derived indexes or UI state must not leak into it.
data.title: M02.1 — Implement canonical configuration and workflow JSON repositories
